researchNotes: Data read from the official afnan.com Shopify product feed (products.json and the rare/historic/edict collection feeds), which lists name, collection and top/middle/base notes; individual product pages and Fragrantica/Parfumo were not opened. 78 perfumes/concentrated oils included; deodorants, travel sets, discovery kits, gift sets and 150 ML duplicate sizes (Supremacy Silver / In Oud / Not Only Intense Luxury Collection 150 ML) excluded. BJ Distribuzione page returned empty content. Concentration comes from variant titles/tags where the body text did not state it. Some oil entries list descriptors (sweet, fruity) as notes exactly as the brand does. The feed was read in text chunks via a summarising fetcher and one product between chunks (a 100 ML Pour Homme at a chunk boundary) could not be identified; the range may therefore be slightly incomplete. Highness collection feed was empty; no release years, perfumers or families published, so left null.

fragrances.name: Stardust
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: about 5-7 h on skin, longer on clothing; longevity 3.0/5, sillage 3.0/5 moderate, projection strong only for the first hour or two. Single review; the product is recent (2026).

fragrances.name: Kiaana Vibes

sources.name: Afnan official site — Kiaana Vibes (product data)

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir: longevity, projection and sillage each 3.0/5; calls it a good everyday scent for warm weather. Perfume.com: 5-7 h typical; a retailer lists 6-8 h and moderate sillage. Most common view: about 5-8 h, moderate sillage.
